blocks.text: Speaking at the third Balangay Forum in Makati City on Sept. 17, Philippine Secretary of National Defense Gilberto Teodoro Jr. warned against China’s attempts to restructure the international order in ways that serve its narrowly defined interests. “They are attempting to reshape the world order to one which is more Sinocentric. A world order with Chinese characteristics,” the defense chief said. He added that “it is scary if that is the future of the world.” Such skepticism stems not only from the Philippines’ experience with China’s illegal, coercive, aggressive and deceptive (ICAD) operations but also from the pattern of Beijing’s strategic […]...
